                              ADMISSION NOTICE FOR ITEP
                                  BAHONA COLLEGE
                               Academic Session :( 2026-2027)

This is to inform all the aspirant students that the admission process for ITEP (B.A./B.Sc. B.Ed.) is
open for the academic session 2026-2027. The Admission Process will be conducted online
through the Samarth Portal. Interested candidates are hereby advised to follow the steps below:

   1. Visit the Samarth Portal: Log into the official Samarth Admission Portal
      (https://assamadmitep.samarth.ac.in/index.php)
   2. Registration: Create an account using a valid email ID and mobile number. Complete the
      registration process by providing the required personal and academic details along with
      NCET registration number. The email ID and mobile number must be same as those
      registered at the time of applying for NCET Exam. Validate the NCET registration using
      OTP for Auto fetching of NCET score.
   3. Fill in the Application Form: Carefully fill in the application form. Select the desired
      course (Secondary/ Middle), Major 2 and Minor etc. and upload scanned copies of
      necessary documents (photograph, signature, mark sheets, etc.).
   4. Submit the Application: After completing all sections, submit the application and take a
      printout of the confirmation page for future reference and also submit the Office of the
      College.
   5. Admission Schedule: Candidates are advised to follow schedule and regularly check the
      college website and Samarth portal for updates regarding merit lists and admission
      confirmation.
